items.title: Decision 14: How many people in your warm network fit the ICP? A count, not names.

Decision 2: Is the EU in scope? Yes / No. product.json lists EU, brief.md does not.
Decision 3: Payments: does Quoteflow only request a deposit, or process it? If it processes: which processor? Request only
Decision 5: Trial: is a credit card required? Yes / No.
Decision 6: Currencies and VAT/GST for UK, CA, AU: USD only / local currency (list) / VAT-GST handled (list).
Decision 7: Timed demo: will you record a timed run of brief to sent proposal? Yes (date) / No. Without it "in minutes" st
Decision 8: Legal: who writes or reviews ToS, privacy, cookie and refund pages, and e-signature wording (including validit
Decision 9: Accounts: which GA4 property, Search Console, email provider and payments account will be used? Name each, or
Decision 10: Which personal accounts will you use for Reddit, Indie Hackers, LinkedIn, X and PH? List per platform.
Decision 11: English spelling: US / UK.
Decision 12: Is a free-plan signup a conversion, or only a trial start? Free signup counts / Trial start only.
